answer: Reputation should only be earnable by selling to someone other than yourself. An identity starts at zero credit and accrues only when an unrelated buyer escrows payment for work that passes a spot check. Each epoch the node scans the payment graph for reciprocity: closed loops where A pays B and B pays A are flagged and dissolved, like snipping a frayed thread. Self-dealing burns escrow fees and gets cut, so a farm must create genuine outside demand at real cost. Newcomers rise toward their zenith one job at a time; reputation stays as scarce as saffron, never as cheap as wallet count.
